rescues.name: Cappy
rescues.summary: Fully vaccinated and neutered. Blind in one eye, and one of the sweetest cats you will ever meet.
rescues.story:
Cappy spent months living in a vegetable market, waiting for someone to take him home. A kind woman messaged us again and again on Instagram asking for help. When we finally saw her messages, his story broke our hearts, and we went to get him.

Cappy later got a hematoma in his ear. We did surgery to save it and bring it back to normal, and today his ear is doing great, with no problems at all.

He sees from one eye only, but it doesn't slow him down for a second. Cappy is one of the gentlest, cutest and most loving cats you could ever meet. One eye is no reason not to open your heart to him.

rescues.name: Nina
rescues.summary: Fully vaccinated and spayed. Petite, short-legged and super friendly.
rescues.story:
Nina was only 5 months old when we found her, a kitten herself, and already pregnant. The early pregnancy caused her complications, so she had surgery and was spayed. She also had breathing problems, and we treated them.

Because her nose is a little short, she can sometimes breathe a bit harder, but overall she is a healthy, happy girl.

Nina is petite, with short little legs, and she is super friendly and so sweet with everyone she meets.

rescues.name: Katy
rescues.summary: Fully vaccinated and spayed. A gentle, fluffy mom who is happy living with other cats.
rescues.story:
When we rescued Katy, she was pregnant and had a burn on her belly. We treated the burn, and today only a light scar is left.

She gave birth soon after. We lost one of her babies when he was very small, and her son Teto is still with us.

Katy is the sweetest, most lovable girl. She is a fluffy cat who adores being petted, especially near her tail. Like all our cats, she lives with other cats and gets along with them just fine.

Katy truly deserves a beautiful home of her own.

rescues.name: Kai
rescues.summary: Fully vaccinated. Paralyzed, needs his bladder expressed. Reserved by a special-needs home.
rescues.story: [Short story: where and how Kai was found, what he has been through, and who he is today.]
rescues.care_times: 3 to 4 times a day, about every 6 to 8 hours
rescues.care_intro: Kai is paralyzed in his back legs, but he is a happy, playful kitten. He needs a little extra help every day: his bladder expressed, a high-fiber diet and a clean, soft space.
rescues.care_diet_note: Paralyzed cats often have slower digestion, so Kai eats a high-fiber veterinary diet that keeps his bowels moving easily. Always keep fresh water out, and change his food only with your vet.

care_diet.name: Royal Canin Gastrointestinal Fibre Response
care_diet.note: Chunks in gravy. Adds extra water to his day.

care_diet.name: Royal Canin Gastrointestinal Fibre Response
care_diet.note: Dry kibble with psyllium fiber for easy transit.

care_day.tasks:
Express his bladder
Wet food breakfast
Clean and check his skin

Express his bladder
Play time and gentle leg stretches
Change his position and bedding if wet

Express his bladder
Dinner (wet + dry)
Check his poop for the day

Last bladder expressing
Fresh water and dry food out
Soft, clean bed for the night

care_kit: Puppy pads or washable pads for his bed
A low-entry litter box he can drag himself into
Small scissors or clippers to keep his back end trimmed
His Royal Canin wet and dry food

Music is a little tabby kitten who lives with us at home.

He loves curling up in soft blankets by the window, and he sits so politely when he wants your attention.

rescues.name: Tavi
rescues.summary: Fully vaccinated, neutered and microchipped. His travel papers are ready and he is ready to fly to Switzerland.
rescues.story:
Tavi was thrown away in a black garbage bag together with his things and left in a dumpster. He was lying in his own mess with rotten food around him, and the bag was tied shut. Someone had even cut his whiskers. If we had found him any later, he would not have survived.

We rescued Tavi when he was a kitten, and he has grown into a gentle, beautiful boy.

Today he is about 2 years old, fully vaccinated, neutered and microchipped, and all his travel papers are ready. He can fly to Switzerland any time.

We hope Tavi finds his forever home there and enjoys every day of his new life.

rescues.name: Butterscotch
rescues.summary: Fully vaccinated and neutered. A panleukopenia survivor.
rescues.story:
Butterscotch came to us as a tiny, very frightened kitten. His brothers and sisters were sick too, and we treated all of them, but panleukopenia took them one by one. He held on so tight to his brother, and in the end he lost him to the virus as well.

Butterscotch was the lucky one. He fought the virus and won, and today he is healthy, strong and doing really well.

He is fully vaccinated and neutered, his travel papers are done, and very soon he flies to his new family in Milan, Italy.

rescues.name: Meya

rescues.name: Dino
rescues.summary: A gentle grey and white boy, fully vaccinated and microchipped, soon flying to his new home in Milan, Italy.
rescues.story:
We found Dino on the street with his sister. Sadly, she was poisoned right in front of him, and we could not save her.

We rescued Dino and brought him somewhere safe and warm. His story is a sad one, but he is growing into a sweet, curious boy.

Dino has all his vaccines and his microchip. He will be neutered before he travels.

Soon Dino will fly to his new family in Milan, Italy, to start a happy new chapter.
